reviews.text:
Following a refurbishment, the infrastructure is very good. And it's proximity to the center of Milan makes it the best choice if you fly here.
UNFORTUNATELY
A potentially 5 star airport is badly put down by the "supervisors"
This morning I waited 45 minutes in a queue to get my boarding pass.
The operator was doing her best in a very professional and efficient manner.
A "supervisor" next to her failed to understand that she needed support (at least 3 lines open instead of 1). Not only, she was getting in the way slowing down operations AND spending time on her phone.
ADVICE for the owner of the airport.
Stop promoting people above their level of competence.

Small efficient airport. Great if you make a city trip to Milan or want to rent a car to tour Italy. Not many shops, but good selection of restaurants and easy and cheap public transport to and from the city.

An international class airport with a high level of service. There is everything. There’s nothing to say. Cafeterias, restaurants, parks for recreation and entertainment, ground and underground parking, the entire infrastructure of communication, from a taxi to a railway station. Ease in any direction thanks to all the information and accessibility. The staff is sociable and responsive, advisors in any matter. the secured security system meets all classes of requirements and levels. Being here you are in bunkers and protected and provided with maximum comfort.
Good Airport,  very useful and very close to get to Milan. Only 2€ for the bus 73 to get to the centre. The Airport has been recently refurbished to good standards.
It is currently under renovation so it will be good to see how it ends up once done.

Clean and well organized. Easy to find any gate or other places. Good restaurants and shops. Also immigration service officers are polite and professional. Information systems work great - physical or web or app or public announcements. Simply good hub for travel locally or long distance.
Airport like, many in Europe. :)

Large modern airport.  All kinds of services and information for passengers are conveniently organized.  All checks are carried out quickly and efficiently.  Complete comfort for transit passengers.  Including the required number of seating areas, Internet access and electrical connection of electronic devices.  Cleanliness and tidiness.

One of the busiest airport I have ever seen. Its huge and highly organized. The cleanliness of the place place is welcoming. Travelers friendly place, occupied with huge numbers of shops, cafes,  shopping centers, duty free shops and spas. The flight timings are perfect. It will take more time to pass between the terminals. Though transports are available.

Beautiful airport, Frankfurt

A fresh and calm place to have a relaxing time for oneself or with Loved one in, before departing. Digging it! Always Love to come back to the airport, with many memories.

Simply a moment of self reflection before taking another flight.

reviews.text:
Clean, well organized, and welcoming airport. It is well signed, in multiple languages, with lots of resources and food.

We stayed at the hotel in the airport the first night, which was perfect for our arrival. Immigration/customs was incredibly fast and welcoming.

As an English speaker, I was worried about how easy it would be to navigate - but I was surprised as to how welcoming the airport (and people, and entire country) was.

I will always, ALWAYS CHOOSE THIS AIRPORT when traveling to Japan. It's definitely a world airport with great food, sometimes really cool presentations like statues or installations promoting Japanese culture. This ace is truly the best. I also love their souvenir shop on the 5th floor be wise it's truly one of a kind. Plus, the service is incredibly friendly and things are made easy by the staff that is present. It just makes for a pleasant experience and that is why I'll always fly through there.

Nice experience in general! The check-in wasn't very complicated and we went through security in under 2 minutes and was very clean and modern. Not bad, not bad. I personally think it can use a bit more shops but of course, there is only so much space in the airport. Liked it!

Well , Japan is always a great country , hospitality, smile , positive airport employees, everything was great and nice full love to Japan and Japanese,  well done , back soon next year. My favorite airport in the world. Clean, easy to transit, chargers are available at many places and drink is not so expensive like other airports.There are two stations and bus terminals. You can follow google maps' guide for your destination. They are easy to find.
Everyone was very nice, and food was delicious. I was very comfortable when I landed there, even though I had just been on a 12 hour flight. Absolutely lovely!

Higashiyama-ku preserves the look and feel of feudal-era Japan in a wood-built historic quarter of narrow lanes lined with traditional pottery stores, tea houses, and restaurants for multi-course kaiseki meals. Nikko is a small city in Japan’s Tochigi Prefecture, in the mountains north of Tokyo. It’s the site of Toshogu, the famed Shinto shrine established in 1617 as a lavish memorial for Tokugawa Ieyasu, founding ruler of the Tokugawa shogunate, or Edo Period. The shrine comprises the gilded Yomeimon Gate, the main sanctuary set in a cedar grove and the tomb itself.

placeMetadata.name: Shibuya City

Shibuya is a special ward in Tokyo, Japan. A major commercial and finance center, Shibuya houses two of the busiest railway stations in the world, Shinjuku Station and Shibuya Station.

Visitors can also see the Hachiko Memorial Statue commemorating a loyal dog and enjoy panoramic views from the popular Shibuya Sky observation deck.

The shrine comprises the gilded Yomeimon Gate, the main sanctuary set in a cedar grove and the tomb itself.

Clean, well organized, and welcoming airport. It is well signed, in multiple languages, with lots of resources and food.

I will always, ALWAYS CHOOSE THIS AIRPORT when traveling to Japan. I also love their souvenir shop on the 5th floor be wise it's truly one of a kind. Plus, the service is incredibly friendly and things are made easy by the staff that is present. It just makes for a pleasant experience and that is why I'll always fly through there.

Well , Japan is always a great country , hospitality, smile , positive airport employees, everything was great and nice full love to Japan and Japanese,  well done , back soon next year.
